ModMetaData.name: LWOP Package [ColonySeries]
ModMetaData.author: Enfants (adapted by ColonySeries)
ModMetaData.description:
LWOP Package is an overpowered convenience mod for RimWorld 1.6.
Main features: - Adds LWOP steel, LWOP wool, LWOP stone blocks, LWOP nutrient agents, and many crafting/refining recipes. - Adds powerful melee and ranged weapons, LWOP power armor, and several equipment ability buttons. - Adds LWOP bionics, chips, quick surgeries, and body-part removal recipes. - Adds the universal LWOP worker mech, able to fight, haul, clean, build, grow, mine, craft, doctor, research, handle animals, and provide childcare. - Adds LWOP storage racks, power buildings, security buildings, pollution pump, air conditioner, transport pods, and transport ship. - Adds LWOP floors, meditation sculptures, food buffs, and extra resource conversion recipes.
